environment: Clean Linux checkout, supported JDKs 21 and 25, Docker and network. Windows leg must run in matching-head CI or an independently capable host; never run Gradle on the Windows implementation workspace. Record host, JDK, Docker, seed, environment and exact commands.
head: 7e23026e2b82e7ecd9d47648441c7a7e4f28f7ff
requirements: Run :solr:core:test --tests org.apache.solr.cli.SolrProcessManagerTest with fixed seed 5323C0DE and fresh XML. Verify matching process returned, foreign PID and port records retained, and unfiltered stale cleanup. With new tests unchanged, demonstrate the deletion regression fails on contributor production code; demonstrate an empty-result mutation fails at the intended assertion. Compilation and setup failures are not proof.

Run :solr:test-framework:catsTests and :solr:packaging:catsTests selecting BasicAuthTest, ExampleTest and SslTest on Linux JDK 21 and 25, seed 5323C0DE. Record fresh per-case XML, counts and skips. The unskipped tlsDiagnosticsDistinguishRejectionFromOtherFailures fixture must execute and pass; mutate the patterns to accept refusal and to reject a documented accepted diagnostic and show fixture failures with tests unchanged.

Run a matching-head Windows CI or independently capable host with :solr:core:test --tests org.apache.solr.cli.SolrProcessManagerTest and :solr:packaging:catsTests selecting BasicAuthTest and SslTest, seed 5323C0DE. Record exact head, JDK, fresh XML, skipped cases and logs. The Windows implementation workspace must not run Gradle. If unavailable mark this proof leg incomplete.

The hostname and mTLS integration cases remain AwaitsFix. When their known underlying failures permit execution, run them explicitly with tests.awaitsfix enabled on both JDKs and record the actual TLS diagnostics, matched/mismatched client certificate controls and refusal controls. Distinguish skip, setup failure or the known underlying defect from proof; do not claim these live cases verified merely from synthetic fixtures. If this cannot be executed, explicitly mark live TLS proof incomplete.

For coverage-only assertions use isolated compiling mutations, unchanged tests and fresh runtime logs: suppress authenticated monitor upload, suppress/corrupt log upload while allowing commit, and replace untrusted TLS endpoint with refusal. Show intended new assertions fail, not setup. Exercise the example-warning regression with an isolated behavior mutation when practical.

Run :solr:packaging:catsTestsDockerBuild --rerun-tasks on a Docker-capable Linux host with network. Verify exactly the upgrade case passes in fresh XML and guard rejects missing/skipped/failed reports. Record candidate image ID and proof it was built from this checkout.

Run tidy and root check -x test. Any formatting change requires commit, push and a new gate. Record all evidence, failures, execution conditions and skips in the named receipt; skipped or missing legs are not passes.

Run unskipped clientHostnameDiagnosticMustBeFreshAndSpecific with fresh XML. Mutate the offset to read stale log data and separately accept generic certificate_unknown; each mutation must fail its intended fixture. Run the live AwaitsFix mTLS case with a matching client certificate succeeding on the same node and a mismatching client rejected, same issuer, EKU, subject, node and settings; capture fresh producer-side hostname diagnostics and control for refusal, unrelated trust, absent certificate, protocol errors, stale logs and supported JDK 21/25 variants. Synthetic fixtures do not prove the live behavior; if a known defect prevents it, record the gate incomplete.
